data.name: Hasilaatun
data.gender_notes: Hasilaatun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hasilaatun is an Arabic name for girls, meaning 'gift of abundance'. It is derived from the root word 'hasil', which means 'fruit' or 'produce'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes the blessings and riches bestowed upon us by Allah. The name Hasilaatun carries the meaning “Gift of abundance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hasilaatun usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of abundance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hasilaatun represents the spiritual abundance and blessings that Allah bestows upon us. It reminds us to be grateful for the gifts we have been given and to strive towards personal growth and self-improvement.
data.etymology: Hasilaatun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of abundance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasilaatun total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Hasilaatun

in_english.long_meaning: Hasilaatun is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb 'حَسِلَ' (hasila), which means to feel or to be sensitive. The name connotes a girl who is beautiful, sensitive, and delicate, attributes that are commendable in Islamic tradition. Derivatives of this verb appear in the Quran, lending the name a certain religious and spiritual significance. Historically, names with such roots have been popular across the Muslim world for their positive connotations and meanings.
